name: devlink
description: Device-agnostic API-link logic every Crusaders firmware needs: the heartbeat body and the interval it adopts, one queued event as the upload body, the roster push and the member-code sync parsed out of a heartbeat response, and the circuit breaker in front of every call. Knows nothing about relays, serial protocols or which box it is running on. No Arduino headers, no heap; compiles for AVR, Xtensa and host.
keywords: device, api, heartbeat, roster, breaker, embedded
